text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Turkish justice minister stresses his country's support for Iraq's sovereignty and unity.
- Information minister meets French parliamentary delegation.
- Open dialogue with Kurds in Baghdad (commentary).
(Above stories except for commentary were also carried by JUMHOURIYA and QADISSIYA)
- Kuwait says normalisation of ties with Jordan has not matured yet.
- Iraqi trade unionists start election congress on Saturday.
